body.mechanism: A genuine NWP interval offset must improve fixed same-run mappings against correctly hour-ended 10-minute SCADA wind across sources, heights, farms and years.
body.treatment: Corrected 10-minute SCADA aggregation plus four frozen NWP mappings and joint day bootstrap.
body.metric: Equal-panel Fisher-z wind correlation with simultaneous lower bound, 12-stratum votes, source signs and coverage; no power score.
